note: Seth Ji ke Case - reasoning cases (founder, 15 Nov): four answers that all look right, one that survives careful thought. Written in the everyday Roman Urdu Pakistanis type on WhatsApp, with the English words they really use (clue, test, report, logic) - no bookish Urdu. Each clue is a fact about one answer (clue i belongs to option i). The founder approves each case (approved: true) before it is played live. 'answer' is the correct option's text. Medical and aviation cases are famous moments from history, told as stories - never advice.

cases.title: Tala Nahi Toota
cases.brief: Jeweller ki shop se raat ko zewar chori ho gaye. Tala nahi toota. Sub-inspector kehta hai: 'Tala bilkul theek hai, matlab chor shop ka apna staff hai - chabi sirf 3 staff walon ke paas hoti hai.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat sub-inspector ki is baat ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Pichle mahine tala lagane wale mistri ne ek extra chabi apne paas rakh li thi.
Teeno staff wale 5 saal se kaam kar rahe hain aur kabhi koi shikayat nahi aayi.
Shop ka alarm ek hafte se kharab tha.
Chori hone wale zewar staff ki kai saal ki salary se zyada mehngay the.
cases.answer: Pichle mahine tala lagane wale mistri ne ek extra chabi apne paas rakh li thi.

clues.label: Tale wala mistri
clues.text: Mistri ne maan liya ke us ne ek extra chabi banayi thi. Woh shop ka staff nahi hai.

clues.label: Staff ka record
clues.text: Saaf record achi baat hai, lekin is se yeh pata nahi chalta ke chabi aur kis ke paas ho sakti thi.

clues.label: Alarm
clues.text: Alarm kharab hone se sirf yeh pata chalta hai ke ghanti kyun nahi baji. Tala kaise khula, yeh nahi.

clues.label: Zewar ki qeemat
clues.text: Itna mehnga maal toh staff ke liye lalach ban sakta hai. Is se staff pe shak aur barhta hai, kam nahi hota.

cases.explain: Inspector ki poori baat is pe khari thi ke chabi sirf staff ke paas hai. Extra chabi wali baat yeh buniyad hi khatam kar deti hai. Saaf record sirf achi image hai, aur alarm ka tale se koi taalluq nahi.

cases.title: Dulhan ka Haar
cases.brief:
Shadi wale ghar se dulhan ka haar gayab hai. Kamre mein sirf 3 log gaye the aur haar in hi mein se ek ne liya. Police ko pakka pata hai ke teeno mein se sirf EK sach bol raha hai.
Shabana: 'Haar Bilal ne liya.'
Bilal: 'Main ne nahi liya.'
Hina: 'Main ne nahi liya.'
cases.question: Haar kis ne liya?
options: Hina ne
Bilal ne
Shabana ne
Pata nahi chal sakta, maloomat kam hai
cases.answer: Hina ne

clues.label: Agar Hina ne liya
clues.text: Tab Shabana jhooti, Bilal sacha, aur Hina jhooti. Yani sirf ek banda sach bol raha hai.

clues.label: Agar Bilal ne liya
clues.text: Tab Shabana sachi, aur Hina bhi sachi (us ne waqai nahi liya). Yani do log sach bol rahe hain.

clues.label: Agar Shabana ne liya
clues.text: Tab Bilal sacha aur Hina bhi sachi. Yani do log sach bol rahe hain.

clues.label: Kya maloomat kam hai
clues.text: Teeno ko bari bari chor maan ke dekhein. Shart yeh hai ke sach sirf ek bole - yeh shart sirf ek hi soorat mein poori hoti hai.

cases.explain: Bilal chor ho toh Shabana aur Hina dono sach bolte hain. Shabana chor ho toh Bilal aur Hina dono sach bolte hain. Sirf Hina chor ho toh akela Bilal sach bolta hai - aur shart yehi thi ke sach sirf ek bol raha hai.

cases.title: Jahaz ki Bimari
cases.brief: Saal 1747. Lambe samandari safar mein jahaz ke staff ke masooron se khoon aa raha hai aur zakhm theek nahi ho rahe. Jahaz ke doctor James Lind ko lagta hai: 'Yeh bimari taza phal na milne se hoti hai.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat doctor ke khayal ko sab se zyada pakka karti hai?
options: Jin 2 mareezon ko roz malte diye gaye woh theek ho gaye; baqi wohi khana kha ke bimar rahe.
Afsar, jin ka khana acha hota hai, staff se kam bimar hote hain.
Port pe pohanch ke zyada tar log chand din mein theek ho jate hain.
Yeh bimari sirf lambe safar mein hoti hai, chhote safar mein nahi.
cases.answer: Jin 2 mareezon ko roz malte diye gaye woh theek ho gaye; baqi wohi khana kha ke bimar rahe.

clues.label: Malton wala test
clues.text: Sab mareez ek hi jagah the aur ek hi khana kha rahe the. Farq sirf itna tha ke 2 ko roz malte mile - aur sirf wohi theek hue.

clues.label: Afsaron ki life
clues.text: Afsaron ko taza gosht, sukha bistar aur kam kaam bhi milta hai. Farq kis cheez se para, yeh pata nahi chalta.

clues.label: Port pe kya milta hai
clues.text: Port pe aaram, saaf paani aur taza khana - sab ek saath milta hai. Theek kis cheez ne kiya?

clues.label: Lamba safar
clues.text: Lambe safar mein thakan, nami aur purana paani - bohat kuch badal jata hai, sirf phal nahi.

cases.explain: Sirf malton wale test mein baqi sab kuch same tha aur ek hi cheez badli. Afsar, port aur lamba safar - teeno mein kai cheezein ek saath badalti hain, is liye wajah pakki nahi hoti. Yeh duniya ke pehle mashhoor medical test mein se ek mana jata hai.

cases.title: London ka Nalka
cases.brief: Saal 1854, London ka ek mohalla. Haize (cholera) se saikron log mar gaye. Sarkari doctor: 'Bimari gandi hawa se phailti hai - dekho, maut badbu wale mohallon mein hi ho rahi hai.' Dr John Snow ko shak hai ke wajah paani hai.
cases.question: Kaunsi baat 'gandi hawa' wali theory ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Usi badbu wali gali ki factory ke 70 mazdoor, jo apne kuein ka paani peete hain, sab theek hain.
Zyada tar maut Broad Street ke nalke ke qareeb wale gharon mein hui hai.
Jin ameer ilaqon mein badbu kam hai, wahan maut bhi kam hai.
Nalke ka paani dekhne mein bilkul saaf hai.
cases.answer: Usi badbu wali gali ki factory ke 70 mazdoor, jo apne kuein ka paani peete hain, sab theek hain.

clues.label: Factory ke mazdoor
clues.text: Mazdoor sara din wohi hawa lete hain jo poori gali leti hai. Farq sirf un ke paani ka hai.

clues.label: Maut kahan hui
clues.text: Nalke ke paas rehne wale wohi badbu wali hawa bhi lete hain. Yeh baat hawa aur paani, dono theory se match karti hai.

clues.label: Ameer ilaqe
clues.text: Kam badbu, kam maut - yeh toh 'gandi hawa' wali theory ke haq mein jata hai.

clues.label: Paani ki shakal
clues.text: Saaf nazar aane wala paani logon ka shak paani se hata deta hai. Hawa wali theory ko is se koi nuqsan nahi.

cases.explain: Mazdoor wohi hawa lete the lekin paani alag peete the - aur bach gaye. Nalke ke qareeb maut hawa se bhi samjhayi ja sakti hai, is liye woh hawa wali theory ko galat sabit nahi karti. Dr Snow ne nalka band karwaya aur bimari ruk gayi.

cases.title: Gawah ki Gawahi
cases.brief: Gawah: 'Main ne raat 11 baje mulzim ko dukaan se nikalte dekha.' Sarkari wakeel: 'Gawah ki mulzim se koi dushmani nahi, usay jhoot bolne ka koi faida nahi. Is liye us ki gawahi bilkul sahi hai.' Aap mulzim ke wakeel hain.
cases.question: Sarkari wakeel ki logic mein sab se bari galti kya hai?
options: Dushmani na ho toh banda jhoot nahi bolta - lekin pehchanne mein galti phir bhi ho sakti hai.
Sirf ek gawah ki gawahi pe kisi ko saza nahi ho sakti.
Mulzim kehta hai ke woh us waqt apne ghar pe tha.
Sarkari wakeel ne gawah se zyada sawal nahi poochhe.
cases.answer: Dushmani na ho toh banda jhoot nahi bolta - lekin pehchanne mein galti phir bhi ho sakti hai.

clues.label: Sach aur sahi ka farq
clues.text: Imandaar gawah bhi galti kar sakta hai: raat ka time, door se dekha, sirf chand second ki jhalak.

clues.label: Ek gawah ka qanoon
clues.text: Qanoon mein ek bharose wale gawah ki gawahi bhi kaafi ho sakti hai. Yeh wakeel ki logic ki galti nahi.

clues.label: Mulzim ka bayan
clues.text: Mulzim ka inkaar ek alag baat hai. Is se yeh pata nahi chalta ke wakeel ki logic mein galti kahan hai.

clues.label: Wakeel ke sawal
clues.text: Sawal kam poochhna ek kami ho sakti hai, lekin yeh us ki logic ki galti nahi. Logic mein is se bari galti maujood hai.

cases.explain: Wakeel ne 'jhoot nahi bol raha' ko 'galti nahi kar raha' samajh liya. Imandaar aadmi bhi andhere mein kisi aur ko mulzim samajh sakta hai. Baqi teeno baatein wakeel ki logic ko touch hi nahi kartin.

cases.title: Wasiyat ka Kaghaz
cases.brief: Wasiyat pe date 14 August 1995 likhi hai; sari jaidad naukar ke naam. Lab ki report: kaghaz us mill ka hai jo 2003 mein khuli; ink 1990 se market mein hai; signature Seth sahab ke asli signature se milta hai.
cases.question: In baaton se kaunsi cheez 100% pakki hai?
options: Yeh kaghaz 14 August 1995 ko likha hi nahi ja sakta tha.
Signature naqli hai.
Yeh wasiyat naukar ne khud banayi.
Seth sahab apni jaidad naukar ko nahi dena chahte the.
cases.answer: Yeh kaghaz 14 August 1995 ko likha hi nahi ja sakta tha.

clues.label: Kaghaz ki mill
clues.text: Mill ka record: pehla kaghaz March 2003 mein bana. Us se pehle yeh kaghaz duniya mein tha hi nahi.

clues.label: Signature expert
clues.text: Expert kehta hai signature asli bhi ho sakta hai - ho sakta hai Seth sahab se baad mein karwaya gaya ho.

clues.label: Kis ne likhi
clues.text: Lab yeh nahi bata sakti ke kaghaz kis ne tayyar kiya. Faida kis ko hai - yeh saboot nahi hota.

clues.label: Seth sahab ki marzi
clues.text: Seth sahab zindagi mein naukar ki tareef karte the. Un ki marzi ka report se kuch pata nahi chalta.

cases.explain: Report se sirf itna pakka hai ke date galat hai - 1995 mein yeh kaghaz bana hi nahi tha. Signature asli ho sakta hai aur likhne wala koi bhi ho sakta hai. Baqi teeno jawab report se aage ki baat karte hain.

cases.title: Aakhri Over
cases.brief: Final ka aakhri over. Doosri team ko 8 run chahiye aur crease pe Zaheer hai. Coach ka mashwara: 'Ball spinner Imad ko do. Aaj us ne 3 over mein sirf 12 run diye - woh hamara sab se acha bowler raha.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat coach ke mashware ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Imad ke teeno over tab hue jab Zaheer crease pe nahi tha - aur Zaheer spin ko bohat maarta hai.
Aakhri over mein bowler pe pressure bohat zyada hota hai.
Fast bowler Hassan ne aaj 2 wicket li hain.
Imad team ka sab se kam umar bowler hai.
cases.answer: Imad ke teeno over tab hue jab Zaheer crease pe nahi tha - aur Zaheer spin ko bohat maarta hai.

clues.label: Imad ke over
clues.text: Scorecard: Imad ne teeno over doosre batsmen ko kiye. Spin ke khilaf Zaheer ka strike rate 190 hai.

clues.label: Pressure
clues.text: Pressure har bowler pe hoga - Imad pe bhi, kisi aur pe bhi. Is se yeh faisla nahi hota ke ball kis ko deni hai.

clues.label: Hassan ka din
clues.text: Hassan acha khela, lekin is se coach ki '12 run' wali baat galat sabit nahi hoti.

clues.label: Imad ki umar
clues.text: Umar kam hone se bowling kharab nahi hoti. Aaj ke 3 over is ka saboot hain.

cases.explain: Coach ki baat '12 run' pe khari hai. Lekin woh run doosre batsmen ke khilaf the, Zaheer ke nahi - aur Zaheer spin ko maarta hai. Yani coach ka saboot aaj ke aakhri over pe fit hi nahi hota.

cases.title: Toss ka Faisla
cases.brief: Semi-final ka toss aap jeet gaye. Vice captain: 'Is ground pe pichle 10 match mein 8 dafa baad mein batting karne wali team jeeti hai. Is liye hum pehle bowling karenge toh hamare jeetne ka chance zyada hai.'
cases.question: Vice captain ne kaunsi baat bina saboot ke maan li hai?
options: Woh 8 teamein baad mein batting ki wajah se jeetin - waise hi zyada achi teamein nahi thin.
Aaj raat ground pe os (dew) zaroor giregi.
Hamari bowling hamari batting se achi hai.
Doosri team pressure mein acha nahi khelti.
cases.answer: Woh 8 teamein baad mein batting ki wajah se jeetin - waise hi zyada achi teamein nahi thin.

clues.label: Un 8 match ki teamein
clues.text: Un 8 mein se 6 match mein baad mein batting karne wali team ranking mein bhi kaafi upar thi.

clues.label: Aaj ka mausam
clues.text: Vice captain ne os ka naam hi nahi liya. Us ki baat sirf pichle 10 match ke record pe khari hai.

clues.label: Hamari team
clues.text: Us ki baat hamari team pe nahi, ground ke record pe khari hai. Yeh maane baghair bhi us ki baat wohi rehti hai.

clues.label: Doosri team
clues.text: Doosri team ke mizaj ka us ki baat se koi taalluq nahi - record mein har tarah ki teamein hain.

cases.explain: Record tabhi kaam ka hai jab jeetne ki wajah 'baad mein batting' ho. Agar woh teamein waise hi behtar thin toh record se kuch pata nahi chalta. Os ek wajah ho sakti hai, lekin vice captain ki baat us pe khari nahi.

cases.title: Darya ya Runway
cases.brief: January 2009: takeoff ke 2 minute baad parinde takraye aur dono engine band ho gaye. Captain ne jahaz Hudson darya pe utaar diya; 155 log bach gaye. Baad mein inquiry committee ne kaha: 'Captain ka faisla galat tha - simulator mein pilot wapis airport pohanch gaye the.'
cases.question: Aap Captain hain. Kaunsi baat committee ki baat ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Simulator ke pilot ko pehle se pata tha kya hoga; asal mein situation samajhne mein 35 second lage.
Darya pe utarna bhi bohat khatarnak tha - paani barf jaisa thanda tha.
Jahaz mein 155 log the, is liye risk nahi liya ja sakta tha.
Captain ke paas 40 saal ka experience tha.
cases.answer: Simulator ke pilot ko pehle se pata tha kya hoga; asal mein situation samajhne mein 35 second lage.

clues.label: Simulator ka tareeqa
clues.text: Simulator mein pilot ne takkar hote hi jahaz mor liya, kyunke usay pehle bata diya gaya tha. Jab 35 second ka delay dala gaya toh har dafa jahaz airport se pehle gir gaya.

clues.label: Darya ka khatra
clues.text: Darya ka khatra toh committee ki baat ko aur pakka karta hai ke airport behtar hota.

clues.label: 155 log
clues.text: Zyada log hon toh sahi faisla aur zaroori ho jata hai - lekin is se yeh pata nahi chalta ke sahi faisla kaunsa tha.

clues.label: Captain ka experience
clues.text: Experience wala pilot bhi galti kar sakta hai. Committee ne experience pe nahi, simulator ke result pe baat ki hai.

cases.explain: Committee ki poori baat simulator pe khari hai - aur simulator asal situation jaisa nahi tha. Jab us mein insaan ke sochne ke 35 second dale gaye toh jahaz airport nahi pohanch saka. Yeh asli waqia hai: 'Miracle on the Hudson'.

cases.title: Fuel Khatam
cases.brief: 1983: ek jahaz ka fuel beech hawa mein khatam ho gaya. Fuel ka meter kharab tha, is liye staff ne haath se hisaab lagaya - aur litre ko kilo ki jagah pound se multiply kar diya. Airline: 'Galti sirf staff ki hai; hisaab unhon ne galat kiya.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat airline ki is baat ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Airline ne usi mahine pound ki jagah kilo ka system shuru kiya aur staff ko training nahi di.
Hisaab do logon ne mil ke lagaya tha, ek ne nahi.
Pilot ne baghair engine ke jahaz safe utaar liya.
Pilot ne khud bhi hisaab dobara check kiya tha.
cases.answer: Airline ne usi mahine pound ki jagah kilo ka system shuru kiya aur staff ko training nahi di.

clues.label: Naya system
clues.text: Yeh airline ka pehla jahaz tha jo kilo pe chalta tha. Staff ko naye hisaab ki koi training nahi mili thi.

clues.label: Hisaab kis ne kiya
clues.text: Do log hon ya ek - dono staff ke hi log the. Is se galti staff se bahar nahi jati.

clues.label: Safe landing
clues.text: Landing ka kamaal baad ki baat hai. Is se yeh tay nahi hota ke fuel ki galti kis ki thi.

clues.label: Pilot ka check
clues.text: Pilot ne check kiya aur phir bhi galti reh gayi - yeh toh staff ki galti ko aur pakka karta hai.

cases.explain: Agar airline ne system badla aur training nahi di, toh galti 'sirf staff ki' nahi rehti - airline ki bhi hai. Baqi teeno baatein galti ko staff se bahar nahi le jatin. Yeh asli waqia hai: 'Gimli Glider', sab log bach gaye.

cases.title: Building mein Aag
cases.brief: 5 manzil ki building ki teesri manzil pe aag lagi hai; chauthi manzil pe 6 log phanse hain. Naya officer: 'Sab ko foran seerhiyon se neeche bhejo. Seerhiyan pakki hain aur aag abhi wahan nahi pohanchi - yeh sab se safe raasta hai.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat is order ka sab se bara khatra dikhati hai?
options: Aag mein zyada log dhuein se marte hain, aur dhuan seerhiyon se hi upar charhta hai.
Seerhiyan tang hain; 6 log ek saath nahi utar sakte.
Phanse hue logon mein ek buzurg hain jo aahista chalte hain.
Building ki lift band ho chuki hai.
cases.answer: Aag mein zyada log dhuein se marte hain, aur dhuan seerhiyon se hi upar charhta hai.

clues.label: Dhuan
clues.text: Garam dhuan seerhiyon ko chimney ki tarah use karta hai. Do-teen saans mein banda behosh ho sakta hai.

clues.label: Tang seerhiyan
clues.text: Tang seerhi se log ek ek kar ke, thori der se utrenge. Yeh der hai, jaan ka khatra nahi.

clues.label: Buzurg
clues.text: Buzurg ko sahara de ke utaara ja sakta hai. Is se raasta safe ya unsafe nahi hota.

clues.label: Lift
clues.text: Aag mein lift waise bhi use nahi hoti. Order seerhiyon ka hai, lift ka nahi.

cases.explain: Officer ne sirf aag ko khatra samjha. Asal qatil dhuan hai, aur woh seerhiyon mein hi bharta hai - 'aag wahan nahi pohanchi' ka matlab 'safe' nahi. Tang seerhi aur buzurg sirf speed kam karte hain.

cases.title: Sailaab ka Faisla
cases.brief: Sailaab mein aap ki boat mein 6 logon ki jagah hai. Masjid ki pakki chhat pe 20 log hain (paani abhi 6 foot neeche hai). Ek kache ghar mein 5 log hain (deewaron mein dararein par gayi hain). Ek darakht pe ek jawan larka hai (rassi se bandha hua). Aap ne boat pehle kache ghar bheji.
cases.question: Aap ka faisla kis rule pe sab se zyada fit baithta hai?
options: Pehle un ko bachao jin ki jaan ko sab se jaldi khatra hai.
Pehle wahan jao jahan sab se zyada log phanse hain.
Pehle bachon aur buzurgon ko bachao.
Pehle un ko bachao jin tak pohanchna sab se aasan hai.
cases.answer: Pehle un ko bachao jin ki jaan ko sab se jaldi khatra hai.

clues.label: Time ka hisaab
clues.text: Engineer ka andaza: kacha ghar ek ghante mein gir sakta hai. Masjid aur darakht kal tak safe hain.

clues.label: Logon ki ginti
clues.text: Sab se zyada log masjid pe hain. Is rule pe chalte toh boat masjid jati, kache ghar nahi.

clues.label: Bachay aur buzurg
clues.text: Masjid ki chhat pe bhi 7 bachay aur kai buzurg hain. Is rule se kacha ghar masjid se pehle nahi aata.

clues.label: Raasta
clues.text: Sab se qareeb darakht wala larka hai. Is rule pe chalte toh boat pehle wahan jati.

cases.explain: Faisla 'kis ko sab se pehle khatra hai' pe tha: kacha ghar girne wala hai, baqi dono abhi safe hain. Ginti wala rule boat ko masjid bhejta aur aasani wala rule darakht pe - sirf 'sab se jaldi khatra' wala rule is faisle pe fit hota hai.

cases.title: Do Chabiyon ki Tijori
cases.brief: Bank ki tijori sirf tab khulti hai jab do chabiyan ek saath lagein: ek manager ki, ek cashier ki. Kal raat tijori khuli aur 50 lakh gayab ho gaye; tala nahi toota. Manager: 'Meri chabi poori raat meri jeb mein thi.'
cases.question: Agar manager sach bol raha hai, toh kaunsi baat 100% pakki hai?
options: Ya toh manager khud tijori pe maujood tha, ya us ki chabi ki duplicate ban chuki hai.
Manager ki chabi ki duplicate zaroor ban chuki hai.
Chori cashier ne ki, kyunke doosri chabi usi ke paas thi.
Chori mein kam az kam do log shamil the.
cases.answer: Ya toh manager khud tijori pe maujood tha, ya us ki chabi ki duplicate ban chuki hai.

clues.label: Manager ki chabi
clues.text: Tijori manager wali chabi ke baghair khul hi nahi sakti. Chabi jeb mein thi - toh ya jeb wala khud wahan tha, ya waisi hi koi doosri chabi lagi.

clues.label: Duplicate ka chance
clues.text: Duplicate ek chance hai, pakki baat nahi. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke manager khud apni chabi le ke tijori pe gaya ho.

clues.label: Cashier ki chabi
clues.text: Cashier ki chabi chori bhi ho sakti hai aur us ki duplicate bhi ban sakti hai. Chabi us ke naam hone se woh chor nahi ban jata.

clues.label: Kitne chor
clues.text: Do chabiyan chahiye, do aadmi nahi. Ek hi banda dono chabiyan (ya un ki duplicate) laga sakta hai.

cases.explain: Tijori ke liye manager wali chabi (ya us ki duplicate) lazmi hai. Asli chabi jeb mein thi - toh ya jeb wala khud wahan tha, ya duplicate bani. 'Duplicate zaroor bani' ek chance ko pakki baat bana deta hai - yehi is sawal ka trap hai.

cases.title: ATM ka Claim
cases.brief: Customer: 'Mera ATM card kal raat 9 baje Karachi mein chori hua aur 9:30 pe chor ne 50,000 nikal liye.' Record: paise 9:30 pe Lahore ke ATM se nikle aur PIN pehli dafa mein sahi laga. Clerk: 'Claim jhoota hai - aadhe ghante mein card Karachi se Lahore nahi pohanch sakta.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat clerk ki baat ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Card ka data aur PIN copy kar ke kisi bhi sheher mein duplicate card banaya ja sakta hai.
Customer 10 saal se bank ke saath hai aur kabhi koi shikayat nahi ki.
Customer ne chori ki report police mein bhi likhwayi hai.
Lahore ke us ATM ka camera us raat kharab tha.
cases.answer: Card ka data aur PIN copy kar ke kisi bhi sheher mein duplicate card banaya ja sakta hai.

clues.label: Card ki copy
clues.text: Bank ki security team: is mahine 'skimming' ke kai case aaye hain - asli card jeb mein rehta hai aur us ki copy doosre sheher mein chalti hai.

clues.label: Customer ka record
clues.text: Acha record achi baat hai, lekin yeh nahi batata ke card aadhe ghante mein Lahore kaise pohancha.

clues.label: Police report
clues.text: Report toh jhoota claim karne wala bhi likhwa sakta hai. Is se clerk ki 'faasle' wali baat nahi toot'ti.

clues.label: ATM ka camera
clues.text: Camera kharab hone se sirf itna hua ke photo nahi mili. Is se claim na sahi sabit hota hai na galat.

cases.explain: Clerk ne maan liya ke paise nikalne ke liye asli card ka Lahore pohanchna zaroori hai. Agar card ki copy ban sakti hai toh us ki baat ki buniyad hi khatam. Acha record aur police report customer ko shareef dikhate hain, clerk ki logic ko nahi torte.

cases.title: Viral Photo
cases.brief: WhatsApp pe ek photo viral hai: 'Aaj Karachi mein barf pari!' Aap ka reporter: 'Photo asli hai. Main ne expert se check karwaya - is mein koi editing nahi hui. Foran chhaap dete hain.'
cases.question: Chhaapne se pehle kaunsa sawal poochhna sab se zaroori hai?
options: Yeh photo kab aur kahan li gayi thi?
Photo bhejne wala banda bharose ke qabil hai ya nahi?
Kya doosre akhbaar bhi yeh photo chhaap rahe hain?
Photo kis mobile ya camera se li gayi?
cases.answer: Yeh photo kab aur kahan li gayi thi?

clues.label: Photo ki date
clues.text: Internet pe search kiya toh yehi photo 2016 mein bhi mili - Murree ke naam se.

clues.label: Bhejne wala
clues.text: Bhejne wale shareef aadmi hain - unhein bhi kisi group se aayi thi. Imandaar log bhi purani photo aage forward kar dete hain.

clues.label: Doosre akhbaar
clues.text: Do website chhaap chuki hain. Lekin galat khabar sab mil ke chhaapein tab bhi galat hi rehti hai.

clues.label: Camera
clues.text: Camera ka model jaan ke yeh pata nahi chalta ke photo Karachi ki hai ya aaj ki.

cases.explain: 'Editing nahi hui' ka matlab sirf itna hai ke photo asli hai - yeh nahi ke woh aaj ki aur Karachi ki hai. Purani asli photo bhi jhooti khabar ban sakti hai. Bhejne wale ka imandaar hona is khatre ko nahi rokta.

cases.title: Ice Cream aur Doobna
cases.brief: Reporter ki khabar: 'Jin mahinon mein ice cream zyada bikti hai, unhi mahinon mein doobne ke waqiaat bhi zyada hote hain. Sabit hua ke ice cream khane se doobne ka khatra barh jata hai.'
cases.question: Is khabar ki logic mein sab se bari galti kya hai?
options: Dono cheezein garmi ki wajah se barhti hain: log ice cream bhi zyada khate hain, nahate bhi zyada.
Reporter ne sirf ek hi sheher ka data dekha hai.
Bohat se log ice cream khaye baghair bhi doob jate hain.
Reporter ne ice cream bechne walon se baat nahi ki.
cases.answer: Dono cheezein garmi ki wajah se barhti hain: log ice cream bhi zyada khate hain, nahate bhi zyada.

clues.label: Garmi ke mahine
clues.text: Data: ice cream aur doobne ke waqiaat dono May se August mein barhte hain - jab log samandar aur nehron pe jate hain.

clues.label: Ek sheher ka data
clues.text: Doosre sheheron mein bhi yehi dono cheezein saath barhti hain. Zyada data lene se yeh galti theek nahi hoti.

clues.label: Baghair ice cream
clues.text: Chand misaalon se 'khatra barhta hai' wali baat galat sabit nahi hoti - khatra barhne ka matlab yeh nahi ke har doobne wale ne ice cream khayi ho.

clues.label: Dukaandaron ki raaye
clues.text: Dukaandar sirf yeh batate ke bikri barhi hai - jo pehle hi pata hai.

cases.explain: Do cheezon ka saath barhna yeh sabit nahi karta ke ek ki wajah doosri hai. Yahan dono ki wajah teesri cheez hai: garmi. 'Sirf ek sheher' wali baat sahi lagti hai, lekin sau sheheron ka data bhi yehi galti dohrata.

cases.title: Mukhbir ki Khabar
cases.brief: Shak 3 musafiron pe hai aur sona in hi mein se ek ke paas hai. Mukhbir: 'Jis ke paas sona hai us ne ticket cash pe liya hai, aur woh Dubai se aaya hai.' Record: Rafiq - Dubai se aaya, ticket card se liya. Usman - Doha se aaya, ticket cash pe liya. Mrs. Khan - Dubai se aayin, ticket ka record nahi mila.
cases.question: Agar mukhbir ki dono baatein sach hain, toh kaunsa jawab sahi hai?
options: Sona Mrs. Khan ke paas hai, aur unhon ne ticket cash pe liya tha.
Sona Usman ke paas hai, kyunke record mein sirf usi ne cash pe ticket liya.
Sona Rafiq ya Mrs. Khan mein se kisi ke paas hai - dono Dubai se aaye hain.
Mukhbir ki khabar galat hai, kyunke cash wala musafir Doha se aaya.
cases.answer: Sona Mrs. Khan ke paas hai, aur unhon ne ticket cash pe liya tha.

clues.label: Mrs. Khan ka ticket
clues.text: Travel agent ka register mil gaya: Mrs. Khan ka ticket cash de ke liya gaya tha.

clues.label: Usman ka safar
clues.text: Usman ka passport: woh Doha se seedha aaya, Dubai gaya hi nahi. Mukhbir ki doosri baat us pe fit nahi hoti.

clues.label: Rafiq ka ticket
clues.text: Rafiq ke ticket ki receipt pe us ke bank card ka number chhapa hai - cash nahi.

clues.label: Khabar kitni pakki
clues.text: Yeh mukhbir pichle 5 case mein har dafa sahi nikla. Aur sawal mein pehle hi maan liya gaya hai ke dono baatein sach hain.

cases.explain: Dono shartein ek saath chahiye: cash ka ticket AUR Dubai. Rafiq ne card diya, Usman Doha se aaya - dono bahar. Bachi Mrs. Khan, toh un ka ticket cash ka hi hoga. 'Sirf Usman ne cash diya' wala jawab bhool jata hai ke Mrs. Khan ka record mila hi nahi.

cases.title: Kelon ka Container
cases.brief: Container ke papers mein likha hai: '18 ton kele'. Lekin weight 26 ton nikla. Malik: 'Farq barf ka hai. Kelon ko thanda rakhne ke liye 8 ton barf rakhi thi, aur barf ka weight papers mein nahi likha jata.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat malik ki is baat ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Container ka fridge 20 din se band hai, andar 35 degree - barf kab ki pighal chuki hoti.
Malik pehle bhi ek dafa galat papers pe jurmana bhar chuka hai.
Usi jahaz ke doosre kele walon ne barf nahi rakhi thi.
8 ton barf khareedna bohat mehnga parta hai.
cases.answer: Container ka fridge 20 din se band hai, andar 35 degree - barf kab ki pighal chuki hoti.

clues.label: Fridge ka record
clues.text: Container ka apna meter: fridge safar ke pehle din hi band ho gaya tha. Farsh pe paani nikalne ke suraakh khule hain.

clues.label: Malik ka record
clues.text: Purana jurmana shak barhata hai, lekin is se yeh sabit nahi hota ke aaj ki baat jhoot hai.

clues.label: Doosre container
clues.text: Doosre container naye hain aur un ke fridge theek the - unhein barf ki zaroorat hi nahi thi.

clues.label: Barf ka kharcha
clues.text: Mehnga hona ka matlab namumkin nahi. Mehngay maal ko bachane ke liye log kharcha kar lete hain.

cases.explain: 35 degree mein 20 din baad barf bach hi nahi sakti, toh 8 ton ka farq barf nahi ho sakta. Purana jurmana aur doosron ka barf na rakhna sirf shak barhate hain - malik ki baat ko seedha galat sabit nahi karte.

cases.title: Akbari Sikka
cases.brief: Ek sahab 'Akbar badshah ke zamane ka sikka' bechne aaye hain. Kehte hain: 'Is ki chandi ka test hua hai - 96% pure nikli, bilkul waisi jaisi Akbar ke sikkon mein hoti thi. Is liye sikka asli hai.'
cases.question: Is baat ki logic mein sab se bari galti kya hai?
options: Pure chandi aaj bhi milti hai - test se yeh pata nahi chalta ke sikka kab bana.
Chandi ka test sirf ek hi lab ne kiya hai.
Bechne wala khud purane sikkon ka expert nahi hai.
Akbar ke kuch sikkon mein chandi 96% se kam bhi hoti thi.
cases.answer: Pure chandi aaj bhi milti hai - test se yeh pata nahi chalta ke sikka kab bana.

clues.label: Chandi aur zamana
clues.text: Sunar ne bataya: 96% pure chandi aaj market mein aam milti hai, aur naqli sikke isi se banaye jate hain.

clues.label: Lab ka test
clues.text: Doosri lab ne bhi 96% hi bataya. Test sahi hai - masla test mein nahi, us se nikale gaye matlab mein hai.

clues.label: Bechne wala
clues.text: Bechne wale ka expert hona zaroori nahi. Us ki baat test pe khari hai, us ke ilm pe nahi.

clues.label: Akbar ke sikke
clues.text: Museum ke asli Akbari sikkon mein chandi 94 se 97% tak hai. 96% usi range ke andar hai.

cases.explain: Test sirf yeh batata hai ke chandi pure hai - yeh nahi ke sikka 450 saal purana hai. Wohi chandi aaj bhi sikke mein dhaali ja sakti hai. Doosri lab se bhi yehi result aata, is liye 'ek lab' asal galti nahi.

cases.title: Darbar ki Painting
cases.brief: Ek painting aayi hai: 'Mughal darbar, san 1650'. Lab ki report: aasman mein jo neela rang hai woh 'Prussian blue' hai, jo 1704 mein pehli dafa bana. Baqi sare rang wohi hain jo 1650 mein use hote the.
cases.question: Report se kaunsi baat sab se pakki hai?
options: Kam az kam aasman wala hissa 1704 ke baad paint hua - chahe repair ho ya poori painting naqli ho.
Poori painting 1704 ke baad bani hui naqli painting hai.
Painting asli hai; aasman baad mein kisi ne repair kiya.
Lab ka test galat hai, kyunke baqi sab rang purane hain.
cases.answer: Kam az kam aasman wala hissa 1704 ke baad paint hua - chahe repair ho ya poori painting naqli ho.

clues.label: Neela rang
clues.text: Prussian blue 1704 se pehle duniya mein tha hi nahi. Jahan yeh rang laga hai, woh hissa us ke baad hi paint hua.

clues.label: Baqi rang
clues.text: Baqi rang purane hain. Naqli painting banane wala bhi purane rang use kar sakta hai - aur asli painting mein bhi yehi hote.

clues.label: Repair ka record
clues.text: Painting ki repair ka koi record nahi mila - na yeh ke repair hui, na yeh ke nahi hui.

clues.label: Lab ka test
clues.text: Lab ne test teen dafa kiya - har dafa wohi result. Baqi rang purane hone se neela rang purana nahi ho jata.

cases.explain: Report se sirf itna pakka hai ke aasman 1704 ke baad paint hua. Poori painting naqli hai ya sirf repair hui - dono ho sakte hain, is liye dono 'pakke' jawab report se aage nikal jate hain. Sab se pakka jawab wohi hai jo utna hi kahe jitna sabit hai.
